title: After the Tenno Sho (Spring): Victory and a New Dream

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower proves to be a spectacular opponent, but Matikanetannhauser wins the spring Tenno Sho. She praises everyone who ran and promises to do her best next time as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our next goal is the Takarazuka Kinen. The following morning, on her way to some independent training, Matikanetannhauser spots Mejiro McQueen running hard.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's deeply impressed, watching McQueen channel her disappointment from the spring Tenno Sho into preparation for the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The medium-distance G1 Takarazuka Kinen is two months away. We need to put everything we've got into training if we're going to win!
